requirement.description: The Design.lookup_domain method fails with TypeError when trying to iterate over _ModuleBuilderDomainSet objects, causing test_domain_lookup to fail. The error occurs because _ModuleBuilderDomainSet doesn't support iteration, but the lookup_domain method assumes all domain containers are iterable.
requirement.contract: The lookup_domain method must properly handle domain lookups regardless of how domains are stored (including _ModuleBuilderDomainSet instances) without raising TypeError.

requirement.description: Simulator tests fail with AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'tick', 'set', 'posedge', etc. These indicate that simulator processes are not being properly initialized or returned from methods that should return valid objects.
requirement.contract: Simulator methods and process management must ensure that all returned objects have proper attributes and are not None when accessed by testbenches.

requirement.description: The domain lookup mechanism in Design class fails to properly traverse the fragment hierarchy when domains are renamed via DomainRenamer, leading to KeyError when domains are expected to exist but aren't found in the expected locations.
requirement.contract: The domain lookup mechanism must properly handle renamed domains and correctly walk the fragment hierarchy to find domains regardless of transformation.

requirement.description: Netlist building fails for memory operations in test_async_read and test_sync_read, indicating issues with how instances with ports are processed, particularly around IO port handling and instance connections in RTLIL conversion.
requirement.contract: The build_netlist function must correctly process instances with ports, handling IO ports and instance connections without failing.
